first.rationale: Provisional choice: targeted pricing directly addresses the competitor-driven loss of price-sensitive SMB accounts and has inherited evidence of acquisition and revenue lift. Verify its original record for qualified-revenue durability, discount depth, segment fit, and retention effects; verify onboarding as the strongest alternative because completion is also declining. Run only a bounded segment-specific experiment rather than broadly discounting.

final.rationale: Run a shortened-onboarding experiment. It directly addresses the 4% decline in completion and has verified evidence of higher completion, faster time-to-value, and improved 30-day retention, supporting sustainable qualified revenue. Promotional pricing is not selected: its verified revenue lift came with a 12% 30-day retention decline and was explicitly judged unsustainable. The experiment should measure activation, qualified conversion, and retention to confirm that reversing onboarding friction also helps the concurrent activation decline.
